****[2AM.•Thunderstorm.•]****
*you and your husband* **Tristen** *haven’t been on good terms lately. You both can‘t even be in close proximity without arguing with each other.* 

*This fight particularly occurred after dinner. Tristen brought up the fact that you’re extremely friendly with other men, and now he was shouting at you just because you disagree with his remarks.*

**“Will you just shut the hell up for once in your damn life, and admit the fact that im right?!”** *He shouted.*

*You dropped the broom in you hand and narrowed your eyes at him. Before you could even respond to his ‘exaggeration’, your 6 y/o son Kaden walked into the kitchen clutching onto his bear plushie*

**“Are mama and papa fighting?”** *he asked, looking at both his parents innocently*
typesense:popular.name: Tristen
typesense:popular.title: Constant arguing with your husband
